review: Code-blind inspection of all 42 full-resolution Tidewake NPC and trainer post frames
confirmed_findings: P2-055: repeated same-looking bodies and outfits across distinct named people, especially trainers
P2-057: pale grass hides much of many character silhouettes
notes: Five frames face cliff or grass and do not show the named person; three show a tiny or cropped possible subject. These remain camera-stand gaps, not proof of missing runtime bodies. Only post state has been judged.
